Mirsario 的 ArmorHelper 的 Python 重写版，
已适配泰拉 1.4.4+ 的复合玩家贴图格式。

模板画法与工作流程与原版完全一致。

en.app.title: ArmorHelper {version} — Terraria armor sheet generator
en.target.head: Head sheet  (Armor_Head)
en.status.noInput: Add at least one input image.
en.status.needImages: The 'Full Armor + Player' outputs need a Terraria Content/Images folder.
en.about.name: ArmorHelper
en.about.description:
Python port of Mirsario's ArmorHelper, updated for the
Terraria 1.4.4+ composite player textures.

The template drawing and workflow are unchanged.
en.about.author: Original tool and template art: Mirsario
en.web.subtitle: Terraria armor sheets, in the browser
en.web.drop: Drop a 128x80 template here, or click to choose (multiple allowed)
en.web.downloadTemplateHint: The downloaded template has the guide overlay drawn on it (toggle it in Preview options)
en.web.written: Also written to the output folder:
en.web.reverseTitle: Rebuild a template from vanilla armor
en.web.reverseSearch: Search Chinese / English name or id
en.web.gifsDrop: Drop the head / body / legs textures into their slots
en.web.gifsHint: No 128x80 template involved: the three finished sheets are sampled in the engine's draw order (legs → back shoulder → back arm → torso → front shoulder → front arm → head).
en.web.gifsNeed: Upload the head, body and legs sheets first.
en.web.gifPlayerHint: When ticked the player's body is drawn first (bundled, so it also works on a phone).
en.web.idsHint: The body id is required; head/legs are looked up when left empty.
en.web.playerHint: The player textures are bundled, just tick it. Pick your own Content/Images in Settings to use that instead.
en.web.outputFolder: Output folder (point it at the game's Content/Images)
en.web.verify: Round trip self check after export (rebuild the template, regenerate, compare)
en.web.guideOverlay: Draw the guide overlay on template previews
en.web.noSets: The armor set table failed to load: data/armor_sets.json is missing or invalid. Make sure the page is served over HTTP, not opened from disk.
en.web.stalePage: The page and the scripts are out of step (missing: {selectors}). Hard reload (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) and try again.
en.web.noFolderSupport: This browser cannot write to a folder; use the download / zip buttons instead. Chrome and Edge can.
en.web.needTextures: Choose a Content/Images folder or upload texture files first.
en.web.needOutput: Choose an output folder in Settings first.
en.web.savedTo: Wrote {count} file(s) to the output folder
en.reverse.title: Rebuild a template from vanilla armor
en.reverse.hint:
The body id is required; head/legs are looked up when left empty.
The template is written to the Output Folder above.
en.reverse.noImages: Choose Terraria's Content/Images folder first (Details panel).
